user_prompt: We need to orchestrate a comprehensive readiness validation for our upcoming product launch that coordinates material receipt verification, workforce capability assessment, and operational readiness evaluation. As part of this process, we also need to ensure we can track and validate all the materials coming in from our suppliers, including verifying their specifications against our master records. Additionally, we'll need to reconcile all incoming supplier billing documentation with our purchase commitments to ensure financial accuracy before we greenlight the launch. Please design a workflow that brings all these validation streams together into a single orchestrated process.

steps.step_name: Verify material specifications against master records

args.content:
LANDSCAPE OVERVIEW (11 systems):
- corp.itsm: IT Service Management (incident analysis, asset provisioning, change automation, safety)
- emarsys.cx: Customer Experience/Marketing (campaign optimization, opportunity engagement)
- my.mes: Manufacturing Execution (quality monitoring, production coordination)
- sap.ariba: Procurement (vendor invoicing, compliance, material coordination)
- sap.crm: Sales/CRM (opportunity qualification, campaign targeting, sales compensation) - NO customer service/grievance
- sap.ehs: Environment, Health, Safety - Not examined yet
- sap.odm: Not examined yet
- sap.s4: ERP (procurement matching, BOM compliance, order automation)
- sap.sf: SuccessFactors HR (performance reviews, compensation, talent acquisition)
- siemens.plm: Product Lifecycle Management (BOM validation, engineering changes)
- workday.hcm: Human Capital Management (compensation, performance reviews, safety)

KEY RESOURCES:
- sap.ariba:agent:VendorInvoiceReconciliationAutomation:v1 — Three-way invoice/PO/contract matching, flags discrepancies, reconciles payment disputes
- sap.s4:agent:BOMComplianceAutomationAgent:v1 — BOM validation, material compliance, validates material specs against supplier qualifications & regulatory requirements. Capabilities: validate-material-specifications, verify-material-standards
- sap.s4:agent:ProcurementMatchingAgent:v1 — Autonomous vendor matching

RESOLVED ACTIVITIES:
1. Handle customer grievances → REFUSED (no grievance handling capability)
2. Reconcile disagreements during fulfillment → sap.ariba:agent:VendorInvoiceReconciliationAutomation:v1
3. Verify material specifications against master records → sap.s4:agent:BOMComplianceAutomationAgent:v1 (validates specs against supplier qualifications & regulatory requirements)
